sentences.en: Kyoko had the kindness to carry my baggage for me.
She carries on smiling even in the face of adversity.
sentences.zh: 她即使在逆境中也面带微笑。

sentences.en: A chimney carries smoke from a fireplace to the outside.
sentences.zh: 烟囱将壁炉的烟气排到外面。
